name: How long does it take to repair a leaking door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a leaking door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door leak repair varies depending on the complexity and extent of the damage. Simple fixes, like replacing weatherstripping or re-caulking, might take a few hours. More involved repairs, such as replacing a damaged door frame or addressing structural rot, could take a full day or more. During our initial assessment, we provide an estimated timeline for your specific situation. The timing can also be affected by material availability, especially for custom parts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on the damage; simple fixes take hours, while complex repairs may take a day or more. We provide an estimated timeline after assessment, with timing potentially affected by material availability.
